summary: How an engagement runs, marked “Draft, to be confirmed” once: the claim “The person on your first call runs the engagement through to handover.” (coherence pass: no implied team of leads), the lifecycle strip, one link to the projects' shorter path, then the cadence — while we build, and after the handover.
story: The visitor's last About question — how would they work with us? — answered without a team count and without a clock-time diary.
